title: Structure your Seedance prompt as a timecoded shot list (e.g., 0:00–0:15) to…
content:
Structure your Seedance prompt as a timecoded shot list (e.g., 0:00–0:15) to force clear pacing, beat-by-beat action, and scene continuity.  
Use an uploaded character sheet as a strict visual reference to lock character identity and outfit consistency across the whole clip.  
Specify camera coverage per beat (wide/close/low angle/overhead/tracking) and explicitly call for rapid angle switches to drive dynamic editing.  
Start “mid-action from frame one” and state “music hitting hard from frame one” to avoid slow intros and ensure immediate momentum.  
Define audio behavior explicitly (continuous orchestral score, city ambience always present, impact sounds on every hit synced to the beat) to control sound design throughout the clip.  
Lock the visual style by stacking concrete render/style keywords (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows) and include negative constraints (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).  
Describe lighting direction and mood precisely (warm ambient lighting from below casting dramatic upward shadows) to stabilize the look across shots.

es.content:
Estructura tu prompt de Seedance como una lista de planos con marcas de tiempo (por ejemplo, 0:00–0:15) para forzar un ritmo claro, acción compás por compás y continuidad de escena.  
Usa una hoja de personaje subida como referencia visual estricta para fijar la identidad del personaje y la consistencia del vestuario en todo el clip.  
Especifica la cobertura de cámara por compás (wide/close/low angle/overhead/tracking) y solicita explícitamente cambios rápidos de ángulo para impulsar una edición dinámica.  
Empieza “mid-action from frame one” y escribe “music hitting hard from frame one” para evitar introducciones lentas y asegurar un impulso inmediato.  
Define el comportamiento del audio de forma explícita (continuous orchestral score, city ambience always present, impact sounds on every hit synced to the beat) para controlar el diseño sonoro durante todo el clip.  
Bloquea el estilo visual apilando palabras clave concretas de render/style (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows) e incluye restricciones negativas (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).  
Describe con precisión la dirección de la iluminación y el estado de ánimo (warm ambient lighting from below casting dramatic upward shadows) para estabilizar el aspecto entre planos.

fr.content:
Structurez votre prompt Seedance comme une shot list horodatée (par ex. 0:00–0:15) afin d’imposer un rythme clair, une action beat par beat et une continuité de scène.  
Utilisez une character sheet téléversée comme référence visuelle stricte pour verrouiller l’identité du personnage et la cohérence de la tenue sur l’ensemble du clip.  
Précisez la couverture caméra pour chaque beat (wide/close/low angle/overhead/tracking) et demandez explicitement des changements d’angle rapides pour dynamiser le montage.  
Commencez « mid-action from frame one » et indiquez « music hitting hard from frame one » pour éviter les introductions lentes et garantir une dynamique immédiate.  
Définissez explicitement le comportement audio (continuous orchestral score, city ambience always present, impact sounds on every hit synced to the beat) afin de contrôler le sound design tout au long du clip.  
Verrouillez le style visuel en empilant des mots-clés concrets de rendu/style (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows) et ajoutez des contraintes négatives (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).  
Décrivez précisément la direction de la lumière et l’ambiance (warm ambient lighting from below casting dramatic upward shadows) pour stabiliser l’apparence d’une prise à l’autre.

ja.content:
Seedanceのpromptは、タイムコード付きのショットリスト（例: 0:00–0:15）として構成し、明確なテンポ、ビートごとのアクション、シーンの連続性を強制します。  
アップロードしたキャラクターシートを厳密なビジュアル参照として使用し、クリップ全体を通してキャラクターのアイデンティティと衣装の一貫性を固定します。  
各ビートごとにカメラの画角（wide/close/low angle/overhead/tracking）を指定し、ダイナミックな編集を生み出すために、素早いアングル切り替えを明示的に指示します。  
「mid-action from frame one」で始め、「music hitting hard from frame one」と記述して、ゆっくりした導入を避け、冒頭から即座に勢いが出るようにします。  
音響の挙動を明確に定義し（continuous orchestral score、city ambience always present、impact sounds on every hit synced to the beat）、クリップ全体のサウンドデザインをコントロールします。  
具体的なrender/styleキーワードを重ねてビジュアルスタイルを固定し（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime、semi-realistic CGI、hand-painted textures、Unreal Engine quality、film grain、hard-edge brushwork、heavy shadows）、さらに否定条件（not cartoon、not Disney、not Pixar）を含めます。  
ライティングの方向とムードを正確に記述し（warm ambient lighting from below casting dramatic upward shadows）、ショット間で見た目が安定するようにします。

ko.content:
Seedance 프롬프트는 타임코드가 포함된 shot list 형식으로 구성하세요(예: 0:00–0:15). 이렇게 하면 명확한 pacing, beat-by-beat action, 그리고 scene continuity를 강제할 수 있습니다.  
업로드한 character sheet를 엄격한 visual reference로 사용해, 클립 전체에서 character identity와 outfit consistency를 고정하세요.  
각 beat마다 camera coverage를 구체적으로 지정하고(wide/close/low angle/overhead/tracking), dynamic editing을 위해 빠른 angle switch를 명시적으로 요청하세요.  
“mid-action from frame one”으로 시작하고, “music hitting hard from frame one”이라고 적어 느린 도입을 피하고 즉각적인 momentum을 확보하세요.  
오디오 동작을 명확히 정의하세요(continuous orchestral score, city ambience always present, impact sounds on every hit synced to the beat). 이렇게 해야 클립 전체의 sound design을 제어할 수 있습니다.  
구체적인 render/style 키워드를 겹쳐 사용해 visual style을 고정하세요(cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows). 또한 negative constraints도 포함하세요(not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).  
조명 방향과 분위기를 정확히 묘사하세요(warm ambient lighting from below casting dramatic upward shadows). 이렇게 하면 shot 간 look을 안정적으로 유지할 수 있습니다.

pt.content:
Estruture seu prompt do Seedance como uma shot list com marcação de tempo (por exemplo, 0:00–0:15) para forçar um ritmo claro, ação beat a beat e continuidade de cena.  
Use uma character sheet enviada como referência visual rigorosa para travar a identidade do personagem e a consistência do figurino ao longo de todo o clipe.  
Especifique a cobertura de câmera por beat (wide/close/low angle/overhead/tracking) e peça explicitamente trocas rápidas de ângulo para impulsionar uma edição dinâmica.  
Comece “mid-action from frame one” e indique “music hitting hard from frame one” para evitar introduções lentas e garantir momentum imediato.  
Defina o comportamento do áudio de forma explícita (continuous orchestral score, city ambience always present, impact sounds on every hit synced to the beat) para controlar o sound design ao longo de todo o clipe.  
Trave o estilo visual empilhando palavras-chave concretas de render/style (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows) e inclua restrições negativas (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).  
Descreva a direção da iluminação e o clima com precisão (warm ambient lighting from below casting dramatic upward shadows) para estabilizar o visual entre os planos.

zh.content:
将你的 Seedance prompt 结构化为带时间码的 shot list（例如 0:00–0:15），以强制实现清晰的节奏、逐拍动作和场景连续性。  
使用上传的角色设定表作为严格的视觉参考，锁定角色身份以及整段视频中的服装一致性。  
按每个节拍指定镜头覆盖方式（wide/close/low angle/overhead/tracking），并明确要求快速切换角度，以推动动态剪辑。  
从“mid-action from frame one”开始，并写明“music hitting hard from frame one”，以避免缓慢开场并确保一开始就有强烈动能。  
明确规定音频行为（continuous orchestral score, city ambience always present, impact sounds on every hit synced to the beat），以控制整段视频的声音设计。  
通过叠加具体的渲染/风格关键词来锁定视觉风格（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows），并加入负面限制（not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar）。  
精确描述光线方向和氛围（warm ambient lighting from below casting dramatic upward shadows），以稳定不同镜头之间的整体观感。
